preview.large_single: Large preview for tensor {shape} draws at most {max} real cells from {total} total.
preview.large_multi: Large preview for tensor {i} {shape} draws at most {max} real cells from {total} total.
preview.hidden: Hidden axes {hidden} keep the head, selected positions, and tail.
reshape.row_major: Values keep their row major order, so element k stays element k.
transpose.keep_colour: Each axis keeps its colour as it moves to its new position.
swapaxes.keep_colour: The two moved axes keep their source colours in the result.
moveaxis.keep_colour: Each moved axis keeps its source colour in the result.
squeeze.none: No size one axes to remove.
squeeze.keep_colour: Each surviving axis keeps its colour, and the removed size one axes are marked.
expand_dims.keep_colour: Each existing axis keeps its colour, and the inserted size one axes are marked.
matmul.dims: Left rows: {rows}, right columns: {cols}, shared inner axis: {inner}.
matmul.combine: The shared inner axis is marked, and the highlighted row and column combine into the first output element.
repeat.copies: Each source element is copied into its own run of result cells, so repeat materialises real copies, unlike broadcast which stretches a size one axis virtually.
take.copies: Each result slice copies a source slice, so repeated indices repeat a slice and reordered indices reorder them.
reduce.combines: Each result element combines {count} values from axis {axis}.
reduce.share_background: Values that fold into the same result share one background with that result element, and the first group is highlighted.
concatenate.seam: Each operand keeps its tint, so the seam along the joined axis is clear.
stack.stacking: Stacking {count} tensors on a new axis {axis}.
stack.new_axis: The new axis indexes the operands, each kept in its own tint.
broadcast.fill: A stretched axis repeats one value, so both operands fill the result shape.
index.new_axis: A new size 1 axis is inserted by None at result position {pos}.
index.axis_removed: Axis {axis} is removed because integer index {index} is used.
index.axis_kept: Axis {axis} is kept because slice {slice} is used.
index.mask: Advanced indexing with a boolean mask.
index.mask_keeps: Elements kept by the mask: {count} (where it is True).
index.gather: Axes {axes} gather positions in shape {shape}. Position count: {count}.
index.slice_separates: A slice or ellipsis separates the integer indexing block, so its broadcast axes move to the front.
index.result_order: The result preserves the index order, including repeated elements.
index.empty_result: The index selects no elements. The result is empty.
matmul.focused: The highlighted row and column combine into the focused output element.
math.empty_contraction: The contraction has no terms, so each output is 0.
reduce.axes_combines: Each result element combines {count} values from axes {axes}.
reduce.scalar: The scalar has no axes to reduce.
reduce.no_axes: No axes are reduced because axis=().
reduce.same_coordinate: Each result element uses the source value at the same coordinate.
reduce.focused: Values that fold into the same result share its background, and the focused group is highlighted.
reduce.keepdims: keepdims=True retains axes {axes} at length 1 for broadcasting. Their result dimensions use the highlight colour.
reduce.empty_mean: The mean of an empty group is undefined and displayed as NaN.
reduce.empty_sum: An empty group contributes no values, so its sum is 0.
trace.empty: The result is empty and has no output coordinate to focus.
trace.empty_mean: NaN (the mean of an empty group is undefined)
numeric.backend_difference: Accumulation dtype, rounding, and overflow may differ from the input array backend.
numeric.generated: Operand {operand} uses generated row-major placeholder values from its shape.
evaluation.per_output_limit: Each output cell requires {count:,} terms, exceeding max_terms={limit:,}. Output values are shown as '?' and were not computed. Set max_terms=None to remove the per-output limit.
evaluation.total_limit: The {outputs:,} visible output cells require {total:,} terms in total, exceeding max_total_terms={limit:,}. Output values are shown as '?' and were not computed. Set max_total_terms=None to remove the total limit.
evaluation.sampled_highlights: Source highlights sample {shown} of {count:,} contribution terms.
memory.header: Memory layout metadata. The figure shows logical indices, not physical addresses.
memory.axis_stride: Axis {axis}: a one-index step changes the byte offset by {stride}.
memory.negative_stride: A negative stride walks backwards through storage along that axis.
memory.empty: Empty tensors have no element addresses to traverse.
memory.zero_stride: A zero stride reuses the same storage along that axis.
memory.view: The reported flags and base describe a view backed by another object.
memory.limitations: These attributes do not identify which earlier operation made a view or copy.
interactive.empty: Empty result: no output coordinate to focus.
flow.heading: Follow the elements that produce {name}.
flow.truncated: This trace stops at {limits}. Hidden steps and sources have not been expanded.
flow.roots: Input occurrences in the full expression. Counts describe paths, not coefficients:
flow.roots_partial: Input occurrences reached in this partial trace. Hidden paths are not counted:
flow.panels_omitted: {count} earlier tensor panel(s) are omitted. Their reached elements remain in the equations.
flow.values_skipped: The shared value budget stopped at {limit} before any array values were read. Values are shown as question marks.
flow.generated: This flow includes generated row-major placeholder values from shape-only inputs.
